description: Shared duration-string language for game_ticks form fields. `core` cases must parse identically on every surface that accepts duration strings (web catalogue, Minecraft clients, Python backend). `client_rejects` cases must be rejected by form clients even though the Python free-text parser reads them; forms demand explicit, exact input while parse_time_string serves fuzzy Discord and inference text. `python_only` documents that looser language. The Rust CLI takes no duration strings: its duration control prompts for a bare integer already denominated in game ticks.

client_rejects.reason: bare numbers are seconds in free text but ambiguous against the CLI's bare-ticks integer prompt, so forms require a unit
free text rounds to the nearest tick; forms reject fractional ticks so nothing is submitted silently rounded
